The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] known as '''Iceman''' hailed from the [[Nord system/Legends|Nord system]], and pursued [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] around the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. He piloted the ''[[Sudden Death]]'', a [[MRX-BR Pacifier]].

==Personality and traits==
Iceman was focused, had no interest in working with others, and showed no mercy to his targets. He was tall, athletic, and emotional displays never crossed his face. His skin was smooth and almost glassy.
